mistake_reason: At step 11, WebSurfer asserted with high confidence that Google Maps shows an 8-minute (650m) walking route between Paintball Fun Cologne GmbH (Brucknerstraße 99) and Kartcenter Cologne (Kelvinstr. 5), including a pedestrian bridge over Bonner Straße and provided a fabricated Google Maps link. This claim is factually incorrect and lacks grounding: those locations are several kilometers apart and not within an 8-minute walk. The agent fabricated specific route details (pedestrian bridge and greenbelt cut-through) and a plausible-looking but unverified link, exemplifying FM-4.1 hallucination.
